description:
Kim Wisheen, who has the ability to handle spirits, is pursuing one particular spirit for revenge. The only clue he has about this spirit is its golden eyes. Before he was able to get his hands on a crucial clue as to the whereabouts of this spirit, his 5 years of efforts were instantly rendered meaningless at the hands of Park Eero and his ghost exorcising stone. All of Wisheen's spirits and spirit artifacts he had collected disappeared!

With the addition of Dongbaek, the daughter of a tiger, rather than being able to take his revenge, Wisheen is slowly being encumbered by hindrances...


**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=818255), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10358546)
